[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/BlKybU61sEHdv4P.jpg[/img]

[b]- Clan/Union:[/b] Unchecking the box blocks PMs from players in your Clan/Alliance.
[b]- Friend:[/b] Unchecking the box blocks PMs from friends on your friends list.
[u]Once you check/uncheck any box and close the settings menu, the changes will be applied.[/u]

* Fixed an issue where equipping the Minerva Helmet would change the character's hair colour to a different one.

- Added a Transparent Minerva option for Minerva voucher types.
- Fixed the Gold / Red Dragon Voucher to give race-specific wings when activated by Karus or Elmorad characters.
- Fixed an issue where “+number” text was appearing on Transparent Minerva items.
* Fixed an issue where the "Add_Friend" command under the Private tab in the menu opened with the "H" key did not open the menu to enter a player name.
* The "Block all merchant messages" option has been removed from the "Block Chatting" menu.
* Number of Magic Bag slots that can be actively used has been increased to 3.

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* Ronark Land Bowl Lobo Boss event has begun! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
- The Lobo Boss will spawn every 3 hours.
- The respawn time may randomly shift forward or backward.
- It drops the same items as the previous Lobo Boss.

[h3][b][ System, Interface, etc. Changes ][/b][/h3]
* A flashing icon feature has been added to the Windows Taskbar under certain conditions.
- When the game is in windowed mode and running in the background, the Knight Online icon on your system's taskbar can now flash to alert you in certain situations.
- This feature does not work when Genie is active, when the game is in windowed mode at maximum resolution, or when it's in full-screen mode.
When the game is in windowed mode and minimized to the background, you will be alerted with flashing in the taskbar in the following situations:
- When you are teleported into events like Chaos, BDW, Juraid.
- When your character dies.
- When a party invitation is received.
- When a trade request is received.
- When your character takes damage.
- When your character makes a sale in merchant mode.
- When you receive a whisper (private message).

* In quests that previously required delivering Acid Potions, the required item has been changed to Stone of Life instead.
* Performance improvements have been made for DirectX 11.
* The issue where abilities selected with right-click on the skill bar sometimes did not show the purple border effect has been fixed.
* The hover effect when placing your cursor over items in the inventory or skills on the skill bar has been made more noticeable.
* Fixed an issue where some recovery abilities on Genie (e.g., Priest's Past Recovery skill) were being activated based on MP ratio instead of HP.
* In the Genie - Support tab, the use of party-wide abilities has been adjusted to be cast based on the person using the skill.

[h3][b][ Ended Events ][/b][/h3]
* The Ronark Land Bowl Lycaon event has ended.
* The Juraid Mountain - Daily Coin Exchange event has ended.
* The Monthly Ranking Event has ended. Rewards have been sent to players who placed on ranks.
- Rewards not received via in-game email will be deleted from the email system after 30 days.

Have fun!
[b]NTTGame | Knight Online Team[/b]

* [b]Juraid Mountain – Daily Coin Exchange[/b] event is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/yFcZsWwLpe8Tm1X.png[/img]
For 4 weeks, by joining the Juraid Mountain event, [b]you can earn 2x “Daily Coin” items when you win and 1x when you lose.[/b]

- The “Daily Coin” item used in this event will be deleted after the event ends.[/u][/b]

[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/LBDhGEUkyQ6fRCH.gif[/img]​

- After accessing the interface, right-click on the item you want to activate from your inventory or drag and drop it into the box. Select the desired cospre option and collect your item.
- The existing exchange menus will be removed during the next maintenance.
- Some exchange tickets will remain to be exchanged in the existing old way.
[b]- With the new system, Kurian / Portu characters can ONLY use Minerva armor types. Valkyrie / Bahamut / Yeniceri / Gryphon types CANNOT be activated by Kurian / Portu characters. If you are playing a Kurian / Portu character, please pay attention to this detail when purchasing these items from PUS.
- Valkyrie / Bahamut / Yeniceri / Gryphon types could be activated on other (Rogue/Warrior/Priest/Mage) character types on the account and could be transferred to Kurian / Portu characters through storage. When worn by Portu / Kurian, appearance changes wont be applied, but attributes will be applied.[/b]

[h3][b][ New Events ][/b][/h3]
* [b]Ronark Land Bowl Lycaon Boss[/b] event has begun! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]

[img]https://filegate.nttgame.com/knight/images/upload/kXjCH9sm2hKqrLW.png[/img]
* [b]Juraid Mountain - Daily Coin2[/b] event is here! [b](4 Weeks)[/b]
For 4 weeks, by participating in the Juraid Mountain event, you will receive [b]2x “Daily Coin2” items upon winning and 1x upon losing.[/b]
- By collecting 30x Daily Coin2 items and delivering them to [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b] NPC, you will earn the right to obtain a [b]“Character Delete Scroll”.[/b]
- To use the Character Delete Scroll item, you must visit [b][Fortune Teller] Mekin[/b] NPC.
- You will need to open the "Character Delete" menu.
- After confirming, you can enter your VIP Key password.
- In the window that opens, you must select the character you wish to delete.
- Once you add the item, accept the final confirmation to complete deletion of the character.
[b]- Character Delete Scroll item is single-use.
- Characters that are in jail, has 10 JR penalties, in a clan, or who are king cannot be deleted.
- A deleted character's name cannot be reused by another character.
- Daily Coin2 items will be deleted when the event ends.[/b]

[h3][b][ System Changes ][/b][/h3]
* The item looting system has been updated in [b]Under the Castle[/b] and [b]Ultima's Dungeon[/b] events.

notes.title: Colony Zone Nation Wars Winners - Temporary Garges Rules
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
As you may know these Garges weapons the winners have received are temporary. The players that won the CZ Nation wars will have them for 30 days, and after the 30 days are gone, that's the end of it.

To keep these items from staying in our game we will have to impose some rules for all those who will receive them, and they are the following.

[b]1. No Trading of the item will be allowed.
2. Bugging the item out of its expiration time is forbidden.
3. No selling of the item or profiting from it is allowed.[/b]

[h1]But why? I wanted to lend it to my friend?[/h1]
Well...you're technically bugging the item and as you may know, [h1][b]Bug Abuse can sanction players according to GMs discression.[/b][/h1]

If you would like to transfer the item to someone for a very good reason, let Lord Kurian know.

Spread the word as we will not discrimante against players that say they're unaware there were rules, it's being posted everywhere.

We have chosen to impose these rules due to the amount of exploits players can cause when bugging the Garges weapons.

We appreciate your understanding.

Best Regards,
Lord Kurian

notes.title: The Level Up Challenge!
notes.notes:
Welcome Knights!
Have you ever wanted to play with or against the Game Masters?
Have you wanted to PK them or just chit chat as you farm or PK with them?
These broadcasts will put GMs into the players shoes and have them play
Knight Online hands on while having certain challenges that may trigger giveaways for the players!

You will be able to see our broadcast at www.twitch.tv/nttgameus

[u][h1][b]SERVERS & SCHEDULE[/b][/h1][/u]

[h1][b]PATHOS[/b][/h1]
GM: Holy Joe
Date: November 27th - 2:00PM EST ~ 4:00PM EST

[h1][b]HELLSGAREM[/b][/h1]
GM: Lord Kurian
Date: November 29th - 5:00PM EST ~ 7:00PM EST

[u][h1][b]GAME MASTER PLAYER RULES[/b][/h1][/u]

[h1][b]GMs CAN USE:[/b][/h1]
- Oreads Voucher
- Speed+ Potion
- Voucher for Magic Bags
- Trina's Piece, Dragon Scales, Shadow Pieces
- Premium HP & MP Potions
- Tattoos
- Pet Transformation Scrolls & AutoLoot
- Redistribution Items
- Buff Scrolls that do not provide EXP
- Hyper Noah Scrolls

[u][h1][b]GMs CANNOT USE[/b][/h1][/u]
- Premiums 
- PUS Items with EXP Buffs
- Wings of any kind

[u][h1][b]GM QUESTS & GIVEAWAYS[/b][/h1][/u]
Viewers of this broadcast have a chance at winning prizes as the GM achieves his goals! 
Join us and help out the GM to get there faster!

- Leave Moradon for the First Time
- Reach Level 45
- Earn 1,000,000 Noah 
- Be in the Winning Team of BDW
- Reinforce an Item to +7
- Obtain a Unique Item
- Obtain a [Self Name] Item

[u][h1][b]SPECIAL SERVER REWARDS[/b][/h1][/u]
Based on the highest level of the GM, we will trigger an EXP Boost for the weekend.
The boost will trigger from Friday until the end of Sunday.

[u][h1][b]ADDITIONAL RULES[/b][/h1][/u]
- Obtaining 1,000,000 Noah will not factor players trading the Noah to the GM.
- There is an Experience Boost cap for 60% should GMs reach level 60.
- In the event a GM is higher level than the other, we will consider the highest GM level character.
- GMs are not able to receive gifted/traded items from players. 

We'll see  you in the Adonis Continent!

notes.title: The Thanksgiving Feastival Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/e25ee32da2b3019f33d658ab485be3569f74c5ed.png[/img]

[h1]Hail Knights!
The Thanksgiving Feastival season is arriving with new activities for you to take part on while you stay in the Adonis Continent. Make the most out of your stay by enjoying this content update arriving on [b]11/07/2018[/b]!

[u][b]NEW QUESTS![/b][/u]

[b]The Stolen Thanksgiving Food[/b]
Defeat the evil monsters that stole the Thanksgiving food and snatch some of the items they took from the store! 


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/50c036cd2ca3188c4b1e78a7f090f90275570e27.gif[/img]

[b]Collect the Thanksgiving Boxes![/b]
Participate in the events such as BDW, Juraid, Forgotten Temple and Chaos to obtain Thanksgiving boxes! Collect enough and redeem epic rewards in-game!

And, if you spend the most amount of boxes…there will be even more epic rewards before the end of November via one of our Twitch broadcasts! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/25888bb81bc96bbce64e708a7f4e735dce3d8c59.gif[/img]

[b]It’s Time To DU-EL![/b]
The minigame [b]YUT[/b] comes to Moradon! If you win enough “Golden Yuts” you may have a chance at redeeming great prizes at random! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/d96e4c15fde915ebb15db63651fc4983db99f615.gif[/img]

[b]Rage of the Lunar Rabbit[/b]
It seems that the Thanksgiving Feastival has harvested too much from the lands of the Adonis Continent and the “Raged Lunar Rabbit” is now lurking in Mora Island! Defeat him for a chance to obtain mysterious prizes!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/7fb8aed2a519873166b031ab958f8ad71c68a465.png[/img]

[b]QUESTS RESET ENGAGED![/b]
Have you completed all the quests in The Adonis Continent?
Are you still maxed out in levels and have the desire to continue questing? 
This season we will be resetting all quests, so you can obtain extra experience!

[Saving Michelle and Sid / Gift of Bilbor / 1st Job Change / 2nd Job Change / Skill Quests / Achievement Quests will NOT be reset]!

We hope to see you soon!
[/h1]

Hail Knights!
We would like to welcome our STKO 2nd Year Anniversary with a series of events YOU WILL NOT WANT TO MISS OUT!

[h1] [b] EVENT SCHEDULE [/b] [/h1]
PATHOS = 2:00PM EST SERVER TIME (EXP Monsters)/2:30PM EST SERVER TIME (Ronark Land) 
CYPHER = 4:00PM EST SERVER TIME (EXP Monsters)/4:30PM EST SERVER TIME (Ronark Land)
HELLSGAREM = 6:00PM EST SERVER TIME (EXP Monsters)/6:30PM EST SERVER TIME (Ronark Land)

[h1] [b]DETAILS OF THE EVENT [/b] [/h1]
We kick off our anniversary with several activities that will be hosted throughout the day on the times listed above, from Server Boosts, EXP Monsters, Boss Monsters to Killing the GM! Now is your chance to experience them on the same day!

During our Anniversary celebration day tomorrow 01/25/2018 , we will activate a 50% server wide 
EXP/NP/NOAH BOOST within all servers from 12:00AM 01/25/2018 Server Time until 12:00AM 01/26/2018! 24 hours of BOOSTS for all players!

However, that is not all, it seems that another Rogue Game Master will be summoning several monsters accross all of Ronark Land! Destroy these evil monsters and get their bounty!

'Please note, Felankor and similar monsters will only be available in the center bowl, every other monster will be spread throughout Ronark Land and it's up to you to find them with or without a party!'

notes.title: Draki's Tower Portal Is Now Open!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/2f8e86136fa50a58b26da5d03dd5cddd13f75f83.jpg[/img]

[h1]
Hail Knights!

Draki's Army is trying to occupy the Adonis Continent using a new portal gate which has just appeared! You must pass through the gate and stop them before it is too late!

[b] [u]HOW TO ENTER[/u] [/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/5e45a6b23135927cf6e04d71eda128d6c5165e80.png[/img]

Draki's Tower can be entered using the teleport gate located in El Morad Castle or Luferson Castle, depending on your Nation.

[b] [u]TIME AND REQUIREMENTS[/u] [/b]
Players may enter Draki's Tower up to 3 times daily.

[b] [u]ADDITIONAL INFORMATION[/u] [/b]
Draki's Tower is a mission that must be completed alone. You may not enlist the help of friends nor your clanmates.
There are 5 floors in Draki's Tower. The first 4 floors contain 6 sections each. There are 8 sections on the 5th floor.

notes.title: BDW Issue Compensations Part 1
notes.notes:

The first stage of this compensation is for the premium players who logged in to the game any time on Wednesday, November 15th, according to game server time (EST).

Please continue to check the newsfeed as we will post more details about additional compensations. Enjoy!

NTTGame || Knight Online Team

Thank you for your consideration! 
-The Knight Online Team.

notes.title: Update Regarding the Recent Outage 5/19/2017
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!

We have some information regarding the outage and I wanted to share it with you all so you can be aware of the situation. 

The problem the servers have been having is related to the Data Center, or more specifically how the game communicates with the Data center. Resulting in highly unstable connections and causing the outages you’ve been experiencing. 

All-important data related to your characters is secure, there is no risk of characters being lost. If there is data loss, it will be related to the last few days since the issue started. 

We are doing our best to resolve this issue and restore service as soon as possible. There will be compensation for the time lost as a result of the outage as well, which will be determined once we have service restored. 

We as a team thank you all for your patience and support. We’re just as hungry to get back into the game as you guys, and as new information becomes available we will make further announcements. 

Thank you, 
The Knight Online Team.

All-important data related to your characters is secure, there is no risk of characters being lost. If there is data loss, it will be related to the last few days since the issue started. 

We are doing our best to resolve this issue and restore service as soon as possible. There will be compensation for the time lost as a result of the outage as well, which will be determined once we have service restored. 

We as a team thank you all for your patience and support. We’re just as hungry to get back into the game as you guys, and as new information becomes available we will make further announcements. 

Thank you, 
The Knight Online Team.

notes.title: Knight Online Celebrates 1 Year on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/5ae11eb9068b3a1d13f6354f172e16704e549514.jpg[/img]

Hail Knights!

To celebrate Steam Knight Online's 1 year anniversary, we have many exciting events and activities planned for our community. Read on to find out what’s coming to Steam Knight Online:

[b][u]1 Year Anniversary Celebration![/u][/b]
This in-game event brings new activities for those that frequent Ronark Land including a new monster and an escort mission which will reward the winning nation! Our Knights will also need to protect the inhabitants of Moradon, as the Burning Chickens will be regrouping for a stronger attack.

[b][u]Celebration Blowout[/u][/b]
Take advantage of the insane sale prices in our Power Up Store! During our event we will be looking to reward 10 random winners from each server to have their purchases doubled!

[b][u]New Capes![/u][/b]
Kings and owners of Delos will stand more proudly as they will be blessed with larger capes that will feature their clan symbol twice as large as the original cape.

[b][u]Felankor Invades Hellsgarem[/u][/b]
A Felankor has been spotted travelling toward Hellgarem’s Ronark Land, and his arrival will reign terror on those who dare to challenge him. Knights of Hellsgarem, prepare to take down this vicious creature!

[b][u]Magical Ink[/u][/b]
New Minerva accessory items will be rewarded exclusively to players who partake in our community and social media based events. These “tattoos” grant powerful buffs to those that wear them. Join our Discord channel and follow our social media pages so you don’t miss out on the action!

[b][u]Level Up, Hellsgarem![/u][/b]
Hellsgarem’s level cap will officially increase to 83 at the end of our 1 year anniversary event!

[b][u]Monster Time Attack[/u][/b]
Last time parties competed to see who can bring Krowaz to his knees the fastest, but this time we’re adding a twist. Who will our parties have to defeat this time? Stay tuned to our announcements to find out…

[b][u]Live Streaming Events[/u][/b]
Due to the success of our broadcast on Discord during the last tournament, we will start streaming select events on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nttgameus]Twitch[/url] in English! This includes the previously mentioned Monster Time Attack as well matches chosen by our community to be highlighted during the tournament! More details to be announced soon.

Keep checking back on our announcements and social media pages for more details on these events, as well as other surprises we’ll have!

NTTGame || Knight Online Team

[b][u]Level Up, Hellsgarem![/u][/b]
Hellsgarem’s level cap will officially increase to 83 at the end of our 1 year anniversary event!

[b][u]Monster Time Attack[/u][/b]
Last time parties competed to see who can bring Krowaz to his knees the fastest, but this time we’re adding a twist. Who will our parties have to defeat this time? Stay tuned to our announcements to find out…

[b][u]Live Streaming Events[/u][/b]
Due to the success of our broadcast on Discord during the last tournament, we will start streaming select events on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nttgameus]Twitch[/url] in English! This includes the previously mentioned Monster Time Attack as well matches chosen by our community to be highlighted during the tournament! More details to be announced soon.

Keep checking back on our announcements and social media pages for more details on these events, as well as other surprises we’ll have!

notes.title: Christmas PvP Battle!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/5a7164c24ef3adfc871a4b86eabde342c1255c5a.jpg[/img]

Hail Knights!
The Holidays are upon us! And what better way to celebrate it than with a special PvP battle for Steam Knight Online! Teams will battle it out for a chance to obtain rewards based on their luck! So, start gathering a full party and prepare for when the sign ups activate for a chance to participate in this small scale PvP event!

[h1]WHAT YOU NEED TO DO[/h1]
- You need to register via the Challonge URLs of your server once they go live to be part of the event.
- If you registered, you need to be available during the times of the event and 15 minutes before the event begins.
- You will have to use your main gear to battle, so start preparing yourself to be a winner!
- You need to have fun! These are friendly matches meant to be fun.
- You need to Create a Team Name and Register the team members in challonge.com
- We recommend you create a team at this time so you can register in the participation URLs once they are activated.

[h1]REGISTRATION URLS [To be announced on 12/12/2016 1:00PM Server Time][/h1]

Pathos - El Morad = http://challonge.com/PathosElmorad
Pathos - Karus =  http://challonge.com/PathosKarus

Cypher - El Morad = http://challonge.com/CypherElmorad
Cypher - Karus = http://challonge.com/CypherKarus

Hellsgarem - El Morad = http://challonge.com/HellsElmorad
Hellsgarem - Karus = http://challonge.com/HellsKarus

[h1]EVENT DETAILS[/h1]
- There will be a total of 10 teams per server, 5 El Morad and 5 Karus so entries are limited and first come first serve! 
- Fights will be 8v8 with only one match taking place! The winner of the match will enter into the Pick the Chest phase.

[h1]DATES OF THE EVENT[/h1]
Registration Process: 12/12/2016 1:00PM Server Time ~ 12/15/2016 1:00PM Server time
Verification of Participants and Announcement of Teams: 12/16
Battle Date: 12/17/2016

Event Schedule:
Pathos – 11:00AM Server Time
Cypher – 12:00PM Server Time
Hellsgarem – 1:00PM Server Time

[h1]WHAT IS THE PICK THE CHEST PHASE?[/h1]
The winners of the match will have a chance to pick between 5 summoned chests. These 5 chests contain different rewards and the chest that will be selected will be the one with the majority of players in the party near to it.
You don't have to kill the chest! We will notify you what you have won. 
The prizes in the chests will be randomly placed and the Game Master will tell you what you have won based on your team's selection.
The full team will earn the rewards of that chest, and the Game Masters will whisper the team members the promo code that includes the rewards in the chest.

[h1]RULES OF THE EVENT[/h1]
- You must be available during the times of the event and must be online 15 minutes before the event begins.
- Your team members must be at least level 75; however, we encourage you to be max level in your server.
- You will not be able to participate with multiple accounts or twice within the event. We will cross check your information.
- Team members who are not connected before the event begins will not be able to join the event.
- If a team member is missing, you will still be able to participate however your team will be handicapped.
- All registrations are final, no changes will be possible once registration ends so choose carefully.
- All rewards are final, you will not be able to change rewards or trade them with team members.
- If you die, you're dead for good, you can't revive and we will not allow the priest revive skill.
- Mages are unable to use Teleport to summon dead players, however you can use it in a supportive way.
- Matches will have a time limit of 10 minutes.
- When you're dead you will be disconnected from the game to prevent revival or teleport from mages.
- We advise you to not revive to prevent from being summoned and get your team disqualified.
- The only items that are forbidden are Abyss Holy Waters and Acid Potions. If we spot you using those your entire team will be disqualified.

[h1]PRIZES[/h1]
[Please note the Chest prizes can be anywhere and the GM in charge will notify you of what you have won.]
Chest Rewards: Trina's Piece, War Premium 15 Days, Red Alencia Wings 30 Days, Valkyrie Armor Certificate, Monster Summon Staff

Chest Rewards: Oreads Voucher, Alencia Wings, Krowaz Pet, Premium HP Potion, Monster Summon Staff

Chest Rewards: Premium HP Potion, Premium MP Potion, Speed+ Potion, Pathos Package, Monster Summon Staff

Chest Rewards: Red Alencia Wings 30 Days, Giga Hammer Pet, M-Game Cat Staff, Valkyrie Armor, Oreads Voucher, Monster Summon Staff

Chest Rewards: Alencia Wings 30 Days, Dryad Voucher, Spirit of Genie, Shadow Piece, Monster Summon Staff

[h1]FAQ[/h1]
Why so little teams? Why not many more teams?
This is the first time we will be running this event. If you enjoyed the event as a participant, make sure to let us know as if it is popular we will create a larger scale one!

Why only one match?
Because it's a friendly Skirmish, we want to reward as many teams as possible not just three teams. There will be a total of 5 winner teams per server.

Where will the match take place?
We will summon you to a private area where the matches will take place.

What happens if no one wins? 
We encourage everyone of you to full on battle at all times during the event, but if no one wins during the 10 minutes, both teams will lose.

What if the matches are unbalanced?
The matches will only be as unbalanced as your equipment difference, however who fights who will be randomly chosen by the GMs.

Everything else is allowed?
With the exception of Abyss Holy Potions and Acid Potions, everything else gear-wise is allowed. But using those mentioned items or using a bug to gain advantage might see your team disqualified.

notes.title: Christmas PvP Battle!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/5a7164c24ef3adfc871a4b86eabde342c1255c5a.jpg[/img]

Hail Knights!
The Holidays are upon us! And what better way to celebrate it than with a special PvP battle for Steam Knight Online! Teams will battle it out for a chance to obtain rewards based on their luck! So, start gathering a full party and prepare for when the sign ups activate for a chance to participate in this small scale PvP event!

[h1]WHAT YOU NEED TO DO[/h1]
- You need to register via the Challonge URLs of your server once they go live to be part of the event.
- If you registered, you need to be available during the times of the event and 15 minutes before the event begins.
- You will have to use your main gear to battle, so start preparing yourself to be a winner!
- You need to have fun! These are friendly matches meant to be fun.
- You need to Create a Team Name and Register the team members in challonge.com
- We recommend you create a team at this time so you can register in the participation URLs once they are activated.

[h1]REGISTRATION URLS [To be announced on 12/12/2016 1:00PM Server Time][/h1]

Pathos - El Morad = http://challonge.com/PathosElmorad
Pathos - Karus =  http://challonge.com/PathosKarus

Cypher - El Morad = http://challonge.com/CypherElmorad
Cypher - Karus = http://challonge.com/CypherKarus

Hellsgarem - El Morad = http://challonge.com/HellsElmorad
Hellsgarem - Karus = http://challonge.com/HellsKarus

[h1]EVENT DETAILS[/h1]
- There will be a total of 10 teams per server, 5 El Morad and 5 Karus so entries are limited and first come first serve! 
- Fights will be 8v8 with only one match taking place! The winner of the match will enter into the Pick the Chest phase.

[h1]DATES OF THE EVENT[/h1]
Registration Process: 12/12/2016 1:00PM Server Time ~ 12/15/2016 1:00PM Server time
Verification of Participants and Announcement of Teams: 12/16
Battle Date: 12/17/2016

Event Schedule:
Pathos – 11:00AM Server Time
Cypher – 12:00PM Server Time
Hellsgarem – 1:00PM Server Time

[h1]WHAT IS THE PICK THE CHEST PHASE?[/h1]
The winners of the match will have a chance to pick between 5 summoned chests. These 5 chests contain different rewards and the chest that will be selected will be the one with the majority of players in the party near to it.
You don't have to kill the chest! We will notify you what you have won. 
The prizes in the chests will be randomly placed and the Game Master will tell you what you have won based on your team's selection.
The full team will earn the rewards of that chest, and the Game Masters will whisper the team members the promo code that includes the rewards in the chest.

[h1]RULES OF THE EVENT[/h1]
- You must be available during the times of the event and must be online 15 minutes before the event begins.
- Your team members must be at least level 75; however, we encourage you to be max level in your server.
- You will not be able to participate with multiple accounts or twice within the event. We will cross check your information.
- Team members who are not connected before the event begins will not be able to join the event.
- If a team member is missing, you will still be able to participate however your team will be handicapped.
- All registrations are final, no changes will be possible once registration ends so choose carefully.
- All rewards are final, you will not be able to change rewards or trade them with team members.
- If you die, you're dead for good, you can't revive and we will not allow the priest revive skill.
- Mages are unable to use Teleport to summon dead players, however you can use it in a supportive way.
- Matches will have a time limit of 10 minutes.
- When you're dead you will be disconnected from the game to prevent revival or teleport from mages.
- We advise you to not revive to prevent from being summoned and get your team disqualified.
- The only items that are forbidden are Abyss Holy Waters and Acid Potions. If we spot you using those your entire team will be disqualified.

[h1]PRIZES[/h1]
[Please note the Chest prizes can be anywhere and the GM in charge will notify you of what you have won.]

notes.title: HALLOWEEN KNIGHTMARE!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/63076467134fc67c6b19ad1a2801dff80ca4d052.jpg[/img]

Hail Knights!

Halloween has once again arrived in Moradon! Scary things are abound, and it's up to our brave Knights to make it right. Complete the quests, collect your prizes, and rid the kingdom of this Halloween Knightmare!

[h1]The Spirit of Ancient Heroes (Level 35+)[/h1]
The ghostly Spirits of Ancient Heroes are haunting El Morad and Luferson Castles!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/bd0a5f4486274ce9311ebb25b0d30d0bf7731c32.png[/img]
Visit the Eslant Fortune Teller located near the back of Moradon castle near [Manager] Billbor to start the quest, then head to your home castle and slay those Spirits! The Eslant Fortune Teller will reward you with a random Mask Piece which can be used to create a special Halloween mask!

[h1]Trick or Treat! (Level 40-60)[/h1]
The Pumpkin Lanterns are hanging around in front of Moradon castle trying to scare the merchants and young Knights in the area! Visit the Ghost Chef near [Tarot Reader] Mekin to start the quest.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/6e210df273a4a3ba748c293f7120df17d868454f.png[/img]
Purchase a Fork from the Sundries NPC and slay the Pumpkin Lanterns to collect 5 Ember Candles to give to the Ghost Chef. He will reward you with some delicious buff candies!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/e63c4eeb0d0bc831b4a5299da2aaa30d60fcd131.png[/img]
Pumpkin Flavored Chocolate - Recovers 720 HP (good for 1 day)
Pumpkin Flavored Jelly Beans - Recovers 1920 MP (good for 1 day)

[h1]Spreading Halloween Cheer[/h1]
Halloween's official mascot, Jack O'Lantern, is paying a visit to Moradon.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11526171/4729c00bb1283660603a6a63cac773af8d782530.png[/img]
He'd like you to spread Halloween cheer to all the people of the Adonis Continent by casting the floating Pumpkin Masks on yourself and fellow Knights. These also carry a blessing of +2 NP for 5 minutes. Complete the task for Jack O'Lantern to receive a piece of Halloween Cane or Halloween Spear which can be used to make a festive weapon! He'll also give a cool Halloween costume to wear (Halloween Transformation Scroll)!

We will watch closely the hotspots in which these illegal users usually appear disrupting fair play.

Currently, we will not apply a Sheriff program, however we will soon open a Discord server for us all in which some of our staff members will usually be around to keep a lookout at your concerns, reports etc.

We thank you for your patience and cooperation!

Best Regards,
Lord Kurian

notes.title: Upcoming Plans - Road to Hellsgarem 09/28/2016
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
This message is to make an announcement about our upcoming plans,
what we want to achieve and the reason why we're taking so long to release launch dates.

Currently, we are internally looking for the best possible server settings
that will please all users who wish to enjoy playing Hellsgarem in English and Spanish.
This has made us dig a little deeper analyzing data with the main goal of bringing a positive impact to Hellsgarem, as well as the current servers we have at hand.

For Hellsgarem, we know, this is something that we keep saying "SOON!"

But, as of today September 09/28/2016 we've almost wrapped up with every plan we have at hand and we'll soon be able to shed light regarding release dates. 

I know I said as of yesterday I was going to release the Launch Date for Hellsgarem today, but it's not just a launch date...
there's plenty more information that we're dying to share with you guys but as said, we've almost wrapped up with our details and we'd rather share everything at once instead of bits and pieces of information every day.

So, once again, please bear with us, tomorrow 09/29/2016 3:00PM PDT we will make an official announcement with launch dates.
You are more than willing to quote me on this.

We thank you very much for your understanding and THANK YOU for your dedication and patience.

Best Regards,
Lord Kurian

notes.title: [Event] Easter Egg-Citement Event
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!

We have some exciting events happening around Knight Online for Easter this year!

[b][u]The Easter Rooster[/u][/b]
Young Knights and Tuareks celebrated Easter by collecting eggs. These eggs were decorated and hidden in scarecrows so that the children could violently tear them to pieces to collect the prize! Little did they know they were being groomed to face the ferocious Easter Rooster! 
This monster will spawn in front of El Morad and Luferson castle every 8 hours during the Easter event. When he is killed, it will drop 50 Easter Eggs and give EXP blessing to players nearby.
What? You thought the Adonis continent’s symbol of Easter was a fluffy bunny?

[b][u]EXP Jackpot[/u][/b]
Hunting monsters has now become an even greater adventure! You’ll have the chance to receive a random amount of bonus EXP from killing monsters!

[b][u]Nation Point Bonus[/u][/b]
The spoils of war just got sweeter. Now you can earn extra Nation Points for enemy kills in battle!

These events will start on [b][i]March 15, 2016, and end on April 12, 2016[/i][/b]. Happy Easter!

NTTGame || Knight Online Team

notes.title: [Event] March Mystery Crates!
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
The March Mystery Crate Madness has arrived to Knight Online with incredible prizes all month long!
There are several mysterious prizes all month long and a three huge mystery crates by the end of the month!
Whoever wins the weekly drawing will receive these mysterious rewards!

[b]Wonder what's in the boxes?[/b]
You will be able to obtain exclusive items that no other user can usually obtain!
From a Cat Staff to an actual physical hoodie and a lot of cash items! But you will actually have to win them in order to have the rewards revealed to you! There will be a total of 4 Mini March crates and 3 BIG mystery crates by the end of the month!

[b]Date of Drawings:[/b]
1st Mini Crate: 03/07/2016
2nd Mini Crate: 03/14/2016
3rd Mini Crate: 03/21/2016
4th Mini Crate: 03/28/2016 
1st Place Mega Crate: 04/04/2016
2nd Place Big Crate: 04/04/2016
3rd Place Small Crate: 04/04/2016
[b][A Total of 7 Winners][/b]

[b]What you need to do[/b]
Any purchase made within our PUS Store will grant you an entry to obtain one of these mystery crates. The more transactions you do the higher the chance for you to win as the names will be duplicated in a list that will then be added into a randomizer software in order to obtain our random winners! Every winner will be announced in the dates mentioned above and rewarded accordingly!

[b]Please Note[/b]
Due to randomizing user sensitive data we will be unable to conduct a live drawing, winners will be announced by 2:00PM EST and announced across all servers.
Winners who have earned one Mystery Crate will not be able to win once again in order to gain assorted winners for this event. 
If you made a purchase on March 1st you are already entered to win!
Please note that multiple purchases does not guarantee a win, it will just increase your chances to win.

notes.title: Steam Chargeback Users [Ban Release]
notes.notes:
Greetings Knights!

We have been contacted by several users due to the ban imposed by Valve Anti-fraud protection system regarding charge-backs which also caused them to be banned from Knight Online. 

Upon further investigation and communication with Steam, we have been able to do the following:

[b]Valve[/b]
- As notified by Steam Support, all the spent currency within Steam Knight Online was returned to your Steam Wallet and/or Payment gateway.

[b]Steam Knight Online[/b]
- All users who have contacted us with proof of release by Steam followed by us verifying such information with Valve are now able to play Knight Online as their ban has now been lifted.

- The items your purchased through our PUS prior to the ban, "Mostly Premiums" have been removed as you were refunded the charged amount by Steam.

If you are one of those who have been affected by a Steam Ban followed by Knight Online ban due to chargebacks. Please make sure to contact Steam support and send us the details of your release.

We thank you for your patience, and we are glad to have resolved this issue for several players.

Best Regards,
NTTGame Support Staff

notes.title: [Hotfix] New Patch Now Available for Download! 01/28/2016
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
We've been hard at work preparing updates and improvements to our servers so you're able to enjoy Knight Online with ease. 
We want your Knight experience to be a memorable one and we are gathering all the users feedback and preparing quality of life improvements! 

[b]We have now implemented a new downloadable patch and this is what you have to do to obtain it:[/b]
- Disconnect completely from Knight Online
- Make sure your Knight Online game Updates
- Download Update
- PLAY THE GAME!

[u][b]What this update includes[/b][/u]

[b]INVISIBLE WINGS![/b]
You can now Hide all the Wings from the game!
We all know there's a lot of hot wings out there running around and sometimes even preventing you from talking to some NPCs. 
This shall no longer be a problem!

How to make the wings invisible/visible: [View attached image]
http://i.imgur.com/jMqSUVR.png

[b]Error Data Gathering[/b]
Any problem logging in to or terminating Knight Online will bring a pop-up that will send the error information directly to our dev team to make sure they are instantly aware of  your issues!

[b]XignCode Errors troubleshooting[/b]
Many of you have been reporting Xingcode issues. This can be caused by launching the game with passion instead of letting Steam load first.

If you are experiencing this issue, do the following:
- Close Steam Completely
- Open Steam and Sign in
- Make sure that Knight Online is updated and it's ready to be played
- Click on Knight Online
- PLAY!
[b][Sometimes users are affected by this issue by click spamming Knight Online without waiting for Xigncode to load properly][b]

Many more quality of life improvements will come soon! 
We appreciate all the support you're giving us!

notes.title: New Premium Swap Service!
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!
We have added a new Premium Swap Service in Knight that will allow you to swap certain premium effects as desired!

[b]What does this mean?[/b] 
You can buy Bronze, Gold and Platinum Premiums from our PUS and activate them at the same time!
Once activated, you can swap between the Premiums as desired.
[b][There is a 30 second cooldown between Premiums][/b]

[b]Does the time stop once I swap from premiums?[/b]
Negative, The time starts expiring at the time of purchase.

[b]Example:[/b]
You purchased Platinum Premium at 10:00AM  
You Purchased Gold Premium at 11:00AM
The Time of expiration "720hours" will run for both at the same time,
however, your Platinum Premium will expire an hour before the Gold Premium.

[b]Limitations[/b]
You can only activate those 3 Premiums at the same time.
The effects of all 3 premiums do not stack.
EXP Premium and DC Premium are not stackable.

[Disclaimer]
You must NOT have those premiums in order to activate EXP and DC Premiums as they will not work with Bronze, Gold and Platinum Premiums at the same time.

notes.title: Knight Online Events Schedule
notes.notes:
Hail Knights!

Below is a list of in-game events that happen on a regular basis (either daily or weekly). Please note that all times are Eastern/Eastern Standard (ET/EST).

[b][u]Border Defense War[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Times: 0:00, 5:00, 9:00, 13:00,  and 18:00

Players of both nations are grouped into an 8 vs. 8 "Capture the Flag" style battle. The primary goal of the event is to capture the Center Monument Crystal by destroying it and return it to your home base. The first team to 60 points, or the team that earns the most points, within the 30 minute war time wins. Border Defense Wars are held in 3 different categores, grouped by player level: Level 20-58, Level 59- 68, and Level 69-80. Stat points are fixed upon entry to provide balanced combat for the participants. All surviving participants receive the Border Security Scroll. Winners also receive a Red Treasure Chest and a healthy amount of experience points.

[b][u]Chaos[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Times: 3:00, 7:00, and 15:00

Obtain the Map of Chaos from [White Shadow Captain] Sirin. Up to 18 participants enter the dungeon for a free-for-all battle. Players are given a standard-use character with a limited skill set to equalize competition. The goal is to kill as many players as possible within the allowed 20 minutes while keeping your death count to a minimum.

[b][u]Forgotten Temple[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Times: 46-59 is held at 10:00 and 20:00, 60+ is held at 1:00 and 16:00

These events are split between 2 level groups: 46-59 and 60+. Up to 80 participants (10 parties) enter this survival-play dungeon through [Priest] Iris in which waves of monsters are spawned, each time with increasing power. The event difficulty varies based on the total number of participants. There will be 5 mini-bosses that spawn during the event that grant stackable buffs. Players gain contribution points  which are calculated based on the amount of damage dealt to monsters. These points will determine your rewards, should you survive the event. Players who die or contribute less than 50,000 will not receive prizes.

Level 46-59:
Top 50% - Green Treasure Chest + 1 Low-Level Forgotten Temple Coin
Lower 50% - Red Treasure Chest + 1 Low-Level Forgotten Temple Coin

Level 60-83
Top 50% - Blue Treasure Chest + 1 Forgotten Temple Coin
Lower 50% - Green Treasure Chest + 1 Forgotten Temple Coin

Fogotten Temple Coins can be exchanged for rewards:
2 Forgotten Temple Coins - Forgotten Temple Green Treasure Chest
3 Forgotten Temple Coins - Forgotten Temple Blue Treasure Chest
2 Low -Level Forgotten Temple Coins - Forgotten Temple Red Treasure Chest
3 Low - Level Forgotten Temple Coins - Forgotten Temple Green Treasure Chest

[b][u]Lunar War[/u][/b]
Frequency: Wednesdays and Sundays
Times: 4:00, 14:00, and 21:00

The first 200 players above level 30 from each nation enter Lunar Valley for a chance to invade the opposing nation. In order to win, players must slay the opposing nation's warders and keeper NPCs. If they are not killed within 1 hour, the nation with the most kills wins. After Lunar War, the winning side may invade the opposite nation, regardless of war participation. Each invasion lasts at least one hour. During this time, the victorious nation's invaders drive their way as far as possible into enemy territory, with the aim of killing players of the opposing nation, as well as capturing Monuments located in enemy territory for Nation Point bonuses.

[b][u]Dark Lunar War[/u][/b]
Frequency: Mondays and Thursdays
Times: 4:00, 14:00, and 21:00

Restricted to the first 200 players from each nation between levels 30-59. The same rules apply from Lunar War, but the winning nation does not get to invade the opposing nation's territory following a victory.

[b][u]Juraid Mountain[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Times: 6:40 and 19:40

A PvP event for players level 70+. Participants from opposing nations are grouped into parties of 8 and start the event on opposite ends of the dungeon map where they will need to fight through 3 separate rooms in order to reach the Final Stage: Devabird. Winning is achieved by killing the boss. If the boss is not killed within the time limit, the number of kills decides the winner. The winning nation will obtain gems which can be turned in to the Chaotic Generator in Moradon.

[b][u]Bifrost[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Times: 3:00, 10:00, 17:00

Players level 70+ gain access to Bifrost via the monument located in the middle of Ronark Land (CZ). The nation which destroys the monument will gain access to Bifrost while the opposing nation will not be allowed entrance for an additional 30 minutes. Inside players hunt monsters associated with the 7 deadly sins for Fragments which can be redeemed at the Chaotic Generator for unique items.

[b][u]Krowaz Dominion[/u][/b]
Frequency: Daily
Time: 12:00 & 23:00

Challenge Krowaz's Dominion, which is full of perilous traps and hideous monsters including Cuff Binder and Giga Hammer. Players level 70+ can access Krowaz's Dominion via NPC [White Shadow] Rider at their nation's camp in Ronark Land if they dare. Inside players can collect materials used to craft Krowaz armors.

[b][u]Castle Siege War[/u][/b]
Frequency: Saturdays
Time: 14:00

A massive PvP battle for clans grade 3 or higher. The clan that manages to capture and defend the center artifact for the longest period during the event will control Delos Castle until the next CSW. As owners of the castle, the clan will be able to set the tax rate for Moradon and be able to collect those funds.

Please note that event times may be subject to change. Check back as we will be adding more events in the future!

NTTGame || Knight Online Team

notes.title: [Announcement] Knight Online Is Coming To Steam!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce that Knight Online will officially arrive on Steam on Monday, January 25, 2016, at 7:00 PM EST. 
This highly anticipated event will introduce a new server that will be accessed exclusively via Steam, separately from the current Knight Online client. 
Please continue to follow us for updates.

Thank you for your support for Knight Online!
